snippet.title: David Get Keen | SAGE 2025 Demo | OUT NOW!!
snippet.description:
A slice of Keen is once again available to play!! David Get Keen is a speedy 3d platformer with a simple but versitile moveset. The visuals are a blended mix of lowpoly, MSPaint, and Memphis Group!!

If you end up playing it, let me know what you think. I'm working towards getting the game finished, and are looking to see if I'm on the right track.


Links:
SAGE 2025 Website: https://www.sagexpo.org/

David Get Keen SAGE booth: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/david-get-keen-sage-2025-demo.2797/
